posts.text: With all due respect to Drew, he misses my point completely. I don’t believe and never claimed that The Odyssey should “fit into my ideology.” Rather it should fit into, or at least accurately represent, the ideology of the characters and time period it portrays. The worldview of a Greek warrior 3,000 years ago is certainly not one I would share on every point. And yet that is the worldview that the film should try to capture. It doesn’t. At all. I’m not sure why this point is so hard to grasp.
